report.subtitle: A short link you received looks suspicious? Report it without creating an account.
report.slugHint: The slug or the address you received, for example abc123 or https://iurl.fr/abc123.
report.emailHint: Only to answer you, never to identify you.

report.successAnonymity: The confirmation does not say whether the link exists: that is deliberate, to protect every client's links.
report.responseTime: A human qualifies every report within 48 hours. A link is never blocked automatically.

page.title: Abuse and reporting
page.subtitle: How to report a link, and what we do with it.
page.step1Body: The report is recorded. No automatic acknowledgement is sent; if you left an email, we may answer you.
page.step2Body: Human qualification: malicious, disputed or unfounded. No report is processed automatically.
page.step3Body: If the link is malicious, it is blocked: the public page answers 403 with an explanation, and the owner is notified with the motive. Aggregated statistics are kept.
page.step4Body: The destination domain is added to our local list, and the account may be suspended. Sign-in and data export remain available.
page.contactBody: The single contact point, for users and authorities alike, is the abuse address. It is also published in the WHOIS and in a DNS TXT record.
page.reportBody: The report form asks for no account, no cookie and no proof. It is the recommended channel for a short link.
page.dsaBody: Infinity URL is a hosting service under the DSA: it stores information at a user's request. It provides a contact point, a notification and action mechanism, and a motive for every restriction imposed on a user.
page.dsaMonitoring: The DSA enshrines the absence of a general monitoring obligation. We do not monitor visitor clicks; we do react promptly to every notification received. This page describes an operational procedure, not a contractual text.
page.legalBody: The acceptable use policy describes prohibited uses and the takedown procedure. The privacy policy describes the data, the retention periods and your rights.
